recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中骨髓球、後骨髓球與帶狀核細胞的核內染色質凝集成粗大塊狀，細胞質顆粒明顯稀少；再加上核分葉不良（hypolobation），呈現 aCML 中「異常染色質凝集症候群」的樣貌。
features: Nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin in large dark blocks
Scattered small dark normoblasts and lymphocytes; platelets scarce
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted granulopoiesis in which myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands have strikingly clumped, block-like nuclear chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm. Hypolobated neutrophil forms are present, and platelets are scarce. Blasts are not increased in this field. The dysgranulopoietic features with abnormal chromatin clumping are suggestive of the syndrome of abnormal chromatin clumping, a variant of atypical CML (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia), pending exclusion of BCR::ABL1 and other defining alterations.

ddx.vs: MDS shows hypolobation with cytopenias but lacks the marked leukocytosis with left-shifted granulocytic expansion seen in aCML.
CML has basophilia and absence of dysplasia, and is BCR::ABL1-positive.
CNL shows mature, well-granulated neutrophils with minimal precursors and no dysgranulopoiesis.
